methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched from official vendor pricing pages via WebFetch on 2026-06-14 and independently re-verified on 2026-06-14. Contentful prices are EUR on their pricing page (Lite €300/mo); GetApp lists the USD self-serve price as $300/month for Lite, which is the figure used. Sanity Free $0 / Growth $15-per-seat / Enterprise custom confirmed from sanity.io/pricing. Storyblok Growth $99/mo and Growth Plus $349/mo confirmed (annual $90.75 / $319.91 via the 'one month free' model, ~8.3% discount). Strapi Cloud: the official page is JS-rendered and returns no figures, but the current self-serve tiers (Free $0, Essential $18, Pro $90, Scale $450, 20% annual discount) are confirmed via Strapi's own blog and costbench.com — corrected from a prior version that listed an invented 'Team' plan with null prices. Hygraph Hobby $0 / Growth $199 / Enterprise custom confirmed. Prismic prices are per-repository, billed annually (Free $0, Starter $10, Small $25, Medium $150, Platinum $675), confirmed from prismic.io/pricing. Directus Core $0 / Team $499 annual ($599 monthly, ~17% discount) / Open Innovation Grant $99 / Enterprise custom confirmed from directus.com/pricing. Builder.io Free $0 confirmed; Pro and Team per-user prices are rendered as images on the official page and no single credible current self-serve figure could be confirmed, so they remain null with a provenance note. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null for all plans as this is a non-telephony vertical.

vendors.name: Contentful
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.contentful.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14 but displays EUR prices only (Lite shown as €300/month, no USD displayed, no currency switcher found). GetApp listing at https://www.getapp.com/content-management-software/a/contentful/pricing/ confirms USD equivalent of $300/month flat for Lite plan. Enterprise is custom/contact-sales only. No USD annual discount rates published.

plans.name: Free

plans.name: Growth

plans.name: Enterprise

vendors.name: Storyblok
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.storyblok.com/pricing fetched twice on 2026-06-14. Growth Plus: $349/month monthly, $319.91/month annual. Premium and Elite are enterprise/custom. GetApp corroborates Growth at $99/month and Growth Plus at $349/month.

plans.name: Starter

plans.name: Growth

plans.name: Growth Plus
plans.notes: $349/month billed monthly; $319.91/month billed annually (one month free = ~8.3% discount). 15 user seats included, up to 20 seats ($15/month per additional). 1 TB traffic/month, 4M API requests/month, 10 locales, 200K AI credits/month.

plans.name: Premium

plans.name: Elite

vendors.name: Strapi Cloud
vendors.provenance: Strapi Cloud self-serve pricing verified 2026-06-14. The official pricing page (https://strapi.io/pricing) is JavaScript-rendered and returns no figures to WebFetch, but the current self-serve tiers and prices are confirmed by Strapi's own blog (https://strapi.io/blog/introducing-yearly-plans-and-new-limits-for-strapi-cloud, which states a 20% yearly-billing discount and Essential at $18/mo monthly / $15/mo annual) and corroborated by costbench.com: Free $0, Essential $18/mo, Pro $90/mo, Scale $450/mo. Annual billing gives a 20% discount. Enterprise (self-hosted edition) is custom/contact-sales. NOTE: a prior version of this entry listed an invented 'Team' plan with all-null prices; corrected to the actual published tiers.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free Strapi Cloud tier. ~2,500 API requests/month, 10 GB storage, limited database entries. Best for personal projects and testing. (The Strapi CMS itself is also free and open-source when self-hosted.)

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: $18/month billed monthly; $15/month with yearly billing (20% discount, per Strapi blog). ~50,000 API requests/month, 50 GB storage, unlimited database entries. Best for small teams and projects.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $90/month billed monthly; ~20% discount with yearly billing. ~1M API requests/month, 250 GB storage, unlimited database entries. Best for growing teams.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: $450/month billed monthly; ~20% discount with yearly billing. ~10M API requests/month, 1,000 GB storage, unlimited database entries. Best for high-scale applications.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Enterprise (self-hosted edition). Custom pricing, contact sales. SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit logs, content history, review workflows, and priority support.
